summary: Describes the problems with spanning tree protocols in IEEE 802.1 LANs, such as strict loop avoidance and unused alternate paths. It then explains the problem and applicability of TRILL, which brings routing to bridging, and the situations suited to it.

eli5.summary: Old networks block extra roads to avoid traffic loops, wasting them. This note explains why using smarter route finding in those networks can make use of the extra roads.
